'''Pieldi''' was a celestial body located in the [[Pieldi system/Legends|Pieldi system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]], which connected it to the [[Pirralor system/Legends|Pirralor]] and [[Velga system/Legends|Velga systems]], while the [[Agarix Trade Route]] linked it to the [[Dramassia system/Legends|Dramassia system]]. Pieldi was a thriving [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that, like all the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the Senex-Juvex, was under the control of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pieldi was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
